baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a refrigerant recovery unit. A composite machine designed to suction refrigerant vapor from refrigeration or air conditioning equipment, filter and cool it, and push liquid refrigerant into an external recovery tank. It consists of an outer casing enclosing a DC motor, a compressor, a condenser, a fan, a digital display board, a control valve, and filters. The refrigerant recovery unit is assembled in Thailand using components sourced from Thailand and China.

The Copper wire, Stator core, Rotor shaft and DC motor are produced in Thailand. The Tubing and sleeves, Motor electronic board, Magnetic ring, Terminal block assembly, Motor back cover, Magnets, Bearing, Motor front cover, Fan air guide cover, Fan, Coupling, Mounting feet, Compressor subassembly, Baseplate and left group plates, Condenser, Sensor, Gears, Control valve, Handle fixing frame, Hook and right plate, Rubber-coated handle and top plate, Membrane keys and transparent panel, Digital display board assembly, Front and back covers, Large knob, Retaining ring, Filter screen and Drying filter are sourced from China. 

Final assembly in Thailand: Assemble fan air guide cover, fan, coupling, and mounting feet onto motor with screws to form motor subassembly; Screw motor subassembly and compressor subassembly together, and install baseplate, left group plates, and condenser; Make wiring connections and install sensor, two gears, control valve, and handle fixing frame; Join hook to right plate and install onto unit, and install rubber-coated handle onto top plate; Affix membrane keys onto transparent panel and secure with digital display board assembly to front cover using screws; Complete wiring connections, align and screw front and back covers to baseplate groups, and install large knob; Solder remaining wires and install retaining ring and filter screen; Test, inspect, and package unit with drying filter.

key_factors: The Chinese-origin compressor subassembly, condenser, control valve, and digital display board assembly.
prediction.decisive_step: Manufacturing of the core refrigerant recovery functional components (compressor subassembly, condenser, control valve, and electronics) in China.
prediction.reasoning: Although the DC motor is produced in Thailand, a refrigerant recovery unit's essential function—suctioning, compressing, cooling, and condensing refrigerant—is imparted by the compressor subassembly, condenser, and control valve, all sourced from China. Similar to N351901 and N347899, screwing pre-manufactured Chinese subassemblies (compressor, condenser, boards, covers) together in Thailand with wiring and soldering constitutes simple assembly that does not substantially transform the Chinese components into a new article of commerce.
